conceptBreakdown.content:
### High-Yield NEST Misconceptions & Exam Traps

| Misconception / Trap | Biological Reality | Exam Tip / Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *"Short-day plants measure the length of the light period to flower."* | Short-day plants measure the **uninterrupted length of the DARK period (Night length)**. | A brief flash of red light during the night prevents flowering in SDPs. |
| *"Auxin promotes cell elongation by making the cytoplasm acidic."* | Auxins trigger $\text{H}^+$-ATPase pumps to acidify the **CELL WALL space (extracellular matrix)**, activating expansins. | Acid growth hypothesis applies to cell walls, not the cytoplasm. |
| *"Abscisic Acid promotes stomatal opening under intense light."* | ABA triggers **STOMATAL CLOSURE** under water stress by inducing $\text{K}^+$ efflux from guard cells. | ABA is the stress hormone; cytokinins/auxins promote stomatal opening. |
| *"Ethylene is a liquid phytohormone applied as Ethephon."* | Ethylene is a **GASEOUS hormone ($\text{H}_2\text{C}=\text{CH}_2$)**. Ethephon is an aqueous compound that releases ethylene gas inside tissues. | Ethylene is the only gaseous phytohormone. |
| *"Cytokinin and Auxin work synergistically to maintain apical dominance."* | Cytokinin and Auxin act **ANTAGONISTICALLY** in apical dominance: Auxin maintains apical dominance; Cytokinin overcomes it. | Cytokinins stimulate lateral axillary bud growth. |
| *"Vernalization stimulus is perceived by mature photosynthetic leaves."* | Vernalization (cold) is perceived by **actively dividing meristems (SAM or embryo)**. Photoperiodism is perceived by leaves. | Do not confuse photoperiodic leaves with vernalization meristems. |
| *"Arithmetic growth produces a sigmoidal S-shaped growth curve."* | Arithmetic growth produces a **LINEAR curve ($L_t = L_0 + rt$)**. Geometric growth produces a **SIGMOIDAL S-curve ($W_1 = W_0 e^{rt}$)**. | $2^n$ geometric growth features lag, log, and stationary phases. |
| *"$\text{P}_{fr}$ is the inactive form of phytochrome that accumulates in the dark."* | **$\text{P}_{fr}$ is the ACTIVE form** generated by red light ($660\text{ nm}$). In the dark, $\text{P}_{fr}$ slowly reverts back to inactive $\text{P}_r$. | $\text{P}_{fr}$ absorbs far-red light ($730\text{ nm}$). |
| *"Dedifferentiation refers to meristematic cells becoming mature functional tissues."* | Mature tissue becoming meristematic is **DEDIFFERENTIATION**. Meristematic cells becoming mature is **DIFFERENTIATION**. | Formation of interfascicular cambium is an example of dedifferentiation. |
| *"Gibberellins induce bolting in woody trees during autumn."* | Gibberellins induce bolting (internodal elongation) in **ROSETTE plants (*Cabbage, Sugarbeet*)** prior to flowering. | $\text{GA}_3$ overcomes dwarfism in rosette plants. |
